title: TWO Adjacent Homes 12 Bedrooms, Sleeps 24, Hot Tub
description:
Two Luxury adjacent homes with stunning skyline views near Germantown & Downtown Broadway bars. 12 bedrooms, 14 beds - sleeps up to 24 people. Each bedroom has a TV. Enjoy 2 private rooftops including hot tubs, lounge seating and a fire pit. Each home also has a game room including wet bars & TVs - one w/ a pool table and another with foosball.  Walk to restaurants, coffee, shopping, bars, Downtown, the Farmers Market & Bicentennial Park. Gas fire places & luxe primary baths with heated floors.

★ 12 Bedrooms, most with their own ensuite bathroom & TV

★ Walk to the Nashville Farmer's Market, Sounds Baseball Stadium, restaurants, coffee shops, bars, live music and shopping / groceries
★ Located next to family-friendly Bicentennial Park, in the heart of Germantown

★ 2 Washers/Dryers

After a fun day out exploring Nashville, come back to relax in this inviting, centrally-located luxury home. All aspects of our home were thoughtfully designed with high-end furnishings. Spend your downtime in the cozy living room, playing pool with friends, or relax in the hot tub on our rooftop patio. The airport is only about 15 minutes away, and there are plenty of affordable Ubers, Lyft and taxis available. Our home is in a great location to enjoy all the things that Nashville has to offer.

At SkyShare Management, hospitality is what we do best. With 15+ years of property management experience, we combine professionalism with a personal touch to make every stay effortless and enjoyable. Our team provides fast, friendly guest support through messaging, seamless check-in with arrival details and access codes provided in advance, and local recommendations to help you discover the best spots and hidden gems the city has to offer.
